description: Reads, creates and edits spreadsheet files (.xlsx, .csv) including formulas, formatting and charts. Use when the user asks for spreadsheet work or mentions Excel.
Extracts text and tables from PDF files, fills forms, merges and splits documents. Use when the user works with PDF files.
Creates and edits Word documents with headings, tables, tracked changes and comments. Use when the user wants a .docx file.
Reviews a pull request for bugs, style and test coverage and writes inline comments. Use when asked to review a PR or diff.
Guides root-cause investigation of bugs and test failures before proposing fixes. Use when encountering any bug or unexpected behavior.
Builds polished web interfaces with deliberate typography, color and layout. Use for landing pages, dashboards and components.
Writes, explains and optimises SQL queries for warehouses and databases. Use when the user needs a query or schema help.
Creates accessible charts, graphs and dashboards with consistent color systems. Use before writing any plotting code.
Drafts and formats Slack messages, announcements and replies. Use when writing or scheduling a Slack message.
Drives implementation by writing a failing test first, then the minimal code to pass it. Use when implementing a feature or bugfix.
